=== List the available encoders

[source,cypher]
----
CALL spatial.encoders.list()
----

.Result

[opts="header",cols="2"]
|===
|name|description
|NativePointEncoder|An encoder for Point geometries that leverages Neo4j's native Point data type for efficient storage.
|NativePointsEncoder|Encodes JTS LineString geometries as arrays of native Neo4j Point types, providing efficient storage for linear spatial data.
|OSMGeometryEncoder|Encoder for OpenStreetMap (OSM) data models. It maps OSM Nodes, Ways, and Relations to JTS Geometries and manages spatial indexing for OSM-specific graph structures.
|SimpleGraphEncoder|Encodes LineString geometries as a linked list of point nodes using FIRST and NEXT relationships. Coordinates are stored as x, y, and z properties on individual nodes.
|SimplePointEncoder|An encoder for Point geometries that maps coordinates to individual node properties. The property names for X and Y coordinates (e.g., longitude/latitude) are configurable.
|SimplePropertyEncoder|Encodes LineString geometries into a single 'data' property as a flattened float array (x1, y1, x2, y2, ...).
|WKBGeometryEncoder|Encodes and decodes geometries using the Well-Known Binary (WKB) format stored in a single node property.
|WKTGeometryEncoder|Encodes and decodes geometries using the Well-Known Text (WKT) format stored in a single node property.
|===
